scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.dev: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; PORT=${PORT:-3000} BASE_PATH=${BASE_PATH:-/} API_TARGET=${API_TARGET:-http://localhost:8080} exec pnpm --filter @workspace/obra-control run dev'
scripts.dev:api: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; PORT=${API_PORT:-8080} exec pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev:all: sh -c 'pnpm run dev:api & pnpm run dev; wait'
